title: WZIP and WLZ4: LZ77 Codecs with Match-Length-Dependent Sliding Windows
summary: An LZ77 codec bounds every match by one sliding window, trading cheap offsets for short matches against reach for long ones. Match-length-dependent windows refine this trade-off: each match length has its own window, and the decoder infers the offset range from the decoded length. We present two such codecs: WLZ4, a byte-aligned LZ4-class format with one-byte and flagged offsets, and WZIP, an entropy-coded Zstandard-class format. Each block begins with its decoded length, from which WZIP derives its widest window and a decoder sizes its output. LZ4 blocks may expand incompressible input by 0.4%; WLZ4 adds at most 15 bytes, WZIP 2. We describe the formats, threaded match finders, decoders and parser. On Silesia, WLZ4 reaches a ratio up to 16% above LZ4HC's, decoding more slowly, and WZIP exceeds Zstandard 22's ratio while its trusted decoder runs at 91% of Zstandard's speed (87% checked; on enwik9, about as fast).
comment: 10 pages, 5 tables, 2 figures. Submitted to the 2027 Data Compression Conference (DCC). Source code: this https URL (release v1.0.0). Distinct from arXiv:2610.06530, which analyzes length-dependent window schedules in theory; this paper presents two complete codecs, their formats, parser and decoders, and measurements against LZ4, Zstandard, Brotli and xz

title: The weight enumerators of irreducible cyclic codes of length $2^\ell$
summary: Using the spectral relation between irreducible cyclic codes (ICC) and generalized Paley (GP) graphs recently found by the authors, we study the weight distribution of irreducible cyclic codes of length $2^\ell$, $\ell \in \mathbb{N}$. These codes were previously studied by Sharma, Bakshi and Raka, who divided them into two families (each having two cases). First we characterize the GP-graphs spectrally related to these families of ICCs: they are complete, semiprimitive, Hamming, or Cartesian products of semiprimitive GP-graphs. We then compute the spectrum of these graphs and hence, by the mentioned spectral relation we finally obtain neat explicit expressions for the weight enumerators of all the irreducible cyclic codes of length $2^\ell$ with $\ell \in \mathbb{N}$.

title: Quantum Annealing for Resource Allocation in Next-Generation Wireless Communication Networks: A QUBO Modeling Guide
summary: Quantum annealing (QA) offers a physics-inspired approach for such subproblems by mapping them onto an Ising Hamiltonian, which is algebraically equivalent to a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) model executable on quantum annealers or hybrid solvers. However, their practical employment in wireless systems critically depends on the specific problem formulation, on the particular variable encoding, constraint handling, solver selection, hardware embedding, and fair benchmarking. This paper develops wireless-oriented QUBO modeling guidelines for QA-assisted resource allocation. We first present a beginner-friendly toy example in which a terrestrial-aerial resource-allocation problem with a fractional signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) maximization objective is reformulated into a two-bit QUBO via Boolean interpolation, converted into an Ising representation, and decoded back into a wireless scheduling decision. The same scheduling is applicable to UAV, aircraft, satellite, and terrestrial links in SAGIN systems. We then review the QA foundations and solver ecosystems, including binary quadratic, discrete quadratic, constrained quadratic, and hybrid models from the perspective of NG wireless optimization. Furthermore, we discuss both binary and discrete encoding, penalty-based constraint conversion, embedding overhead, solution decoding, and feasibility verification. A QUBO Compatibility Index is introduced as a lightweight diagnostic metric for assessing the associated QUBO formulation readiness, rather than a predictor of runtime or solution quality. Finally, a case study on max-min uplink power control in cell-free massive MIMO illustrates how a fairness-oriented wireless problem can be discretized, constrained, converted into the concept of a QUBO, and evaluated against classical baselines. A host of key challenges and future directions are also discussed.

title: Sequential Change Point Detection for PSK Modulation Switching
summary: Transmitters in adaptive communication systems may switch their modulation scheme at an unknown time, and a receiver must detect this switch quickly without raising frequent false alarms. Existing modulation classification methods label a finite block of received data and do not provide stopping rules with controlled false-alarm and delay performance. We study the sequential detection of a switch from one phase shift keying (PSK) scheme to another over an additive white Gaussian noise channel. We build cumulative-sum (CUSUM) and moving-sum (MOSUM) detectors from the log-likelihood ratio and its low-SNR approximation. For a switch from quadrature PSK to binary PSK, we derive the moment-generating function and probability density function of the approximate statistic. We use them to relate the CUSUM threshold to the average run length to false alarm and the worst-case detection delay. For a switch between any two PSK orders, we approximate the vector of overlapping MOSUM statistics as multivariate Gaussian and obtain bounds on both measures. Monte Carlo simulations show that our derived expressions for ARL2FA and WADD closely match the empirical results across thresholds, validating the accuracy of the proposed analytical approximations and theoretical bounds.

title: Orthogonal SC-LDPC Codes for the IDS Channel
summary: We propose a coding scheme for the insertion, deletion and substitution (IDS) channel tailored to the short strands of DNA-based data storage. Instead of an inner synchronisation code, a spatially coupled LDPC (SC-LDPC) code is placed across the strands, with its coupling axis aligned to the position along the strands. Every decoded position thus becomes an anchor to synchronise the neighbouring strands. The decoding waves of the SC-LDPC code carry these anchors from both ends of the strands towards the middle. We bound the achievable rate from above by the information rate of a single strand and from below by that of a separated receiver. For strands of 100 nucleotides (the relevant regime for DNA-based data storage), our scheme outperforms a rate-matched concatenated construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对DNA数据存储短链的插入-删除-替换（IDS）信道编码方案，用空间耦合LDPC码跨链耦合替代内层同步码，并给出可达速率上下界。

AI.method: 在链间放置空间耦合LDPC（SC-LDPC）码，使其耦合轴与链内位置方向对齐，使每个已译码位置成为相邻链的同步锚点，译码波从链两端向中间传播实现同步；并从单链信息速率给出上界、从分离接收机速率给出下界。

title: Low-Latency LDPC Decoding Based on Consensus and Return Residual Belief Propagation
summary: We propose two new decoding algorithms for low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes. The Consensus and Return residual belief propagation (C&R-RBP) algorithm reduces the number of iterations required to achieve a target decoding error rate over an AWGN channel by exploiting the availability of updated information, thereby mitigating the performance degradation caused by the greedy behavior of RBP-based algorithms and reducing error propagation. The Consensus and Delayed Return RBP algorithm (C&DR-RBP) achieves better performance in the early decoding iterations than C&R-RBP, making it particularly suitable for low-latency applications. Both proposed methods maintain the same computational complexity as the original RBP algorithm in terms of residual calculations. We also provide a formal analysis showing that the Consensus mechanism increases the probability of correct bit decisions under initial decoding conditions and in the presence of severe bit transmission errors, providing insight into the performance gains observed in the simulations. Numerical results based on the rapidly growing 5G New Radio (NR) standard, considering different code lengths, code rates, and channel models, demonstrate that both methods outperform competing RBP-based algorithms with similar overall computational complexity in terms of frame error rate (FER) and bit error rate (BER).
comment: 16 figures, 21 pages

title: DS and AMDS Symbol-Pair Codes from Three Families of Simple Root Cyclic Codes
summary: Symbol-pair distances of simple-root cyclic codes are important for evaluating error correction performance under overlapping pair read channels. In this paper, we construct three families of simple-root cyclic codes over finite fields of odd characteristic via generator polynomials. For length \(2q+2\), the minimum symbol-pair distance is \(10\) for every odd prime power \(q\ge 7\), established by excluding invalid support configurations. For length \(4q-4\), when \(q\equiv 3\pmod 4\) and finite field constraints hold, it is \(9\) or \(10\). For length \(2(q-1)\), reciprocal-polynomial analysis shows it is \(11\) or \(12\). All obtained codes are MDS or AMDS symbol-pair codes.

AI.tldr: 该论文构造了三类奇特征有限域上的单根循环码，并确定其符号对最小距离分别为10、9或10、11或12，所得码为MDS或AMDS符号对码。
AI.motivation: 符号对距离对于评估重叠符号对读取信道下的纠错性能具有重要价值，因此需要构造并分析具有优良符号对距离的循环码。
AI.method: 通过生成多项式构造长度为2q+2、4q-4、2(q-1)的三类单根循环码，并利用排除无效支撑配置和互反多项式分析来确定符号对最小距离。

title: Mutual Coupling and Visibility Effects in 2D Holographic Curvature-Reconfigurable Apertures
summary: Holographic multiple-input multiple-output arrays provide high spatial resolution and flexible wavefront control, but curved or conformal deployments jointly introduce curvature, mutual coupling (MC), and direction-dependent visibility. This paper studies a two-dimensional (2D) holographic curvaturereconfigurable aperture (HoloCuRA). A geometry-based model characterizes element positions, steering, and spatial correlation, while an impedance-based coupling matrix and a visibility vector capture electromagnetic interactions and shadowing. Relative directivity and spectral efficiency are evaluated versus curvature. Results show that MC mainly reshapes local directivity fluctuations, whereas visibility dominates the global pattern and spectral-efficiency variation under both isotropic scattering and CDL-A channels.

title: UAV SAR Imaging via Diffusion Posterior Sampling under Non-Ideal Motion in ISAC Systems
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle-enabled synthetic aperture radar (SAR) offers significant potential for providing communication services to ground users while sensing the surrounding environment in low-altitude integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems. However, its practical deployment is challenged by known non-ULM trajectories and unknown position errors, which violate conventional SAR assumptions and cause severe image defocusing. We address these non-ideal impacts by formulating the ISAC SAR imaging as an exact linear inverse problem to accurately model arbitrary trajectories with multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency division multiplexing waveforms. Based on this formulation, we develop a diffusion posterior sampling (DPS)-based super-resolution SAR framework, where a pre-trained diffusion model provides a data-driven image prior and the exact physical model enforces measurement consistency during posterior inference. The inference process is further accelerated for practical implementation. For unknown position errors, we develop a joint iterative DPS and motion compensation (MoCo) optimization algorithm with discrete cosine transform reparameterization and coarse-to-fine spectral scheduling. Simulations demonstrate that our framework achieves high-accuracy reconstruction across diverse trajectories and remarkable super-resolution, maintaining greater than 21.3 dB peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) even under half physical resolution truncation. Under unknown motion errors, the joint DPS and MoCo algorithm achieves 23.65 dB PSNR with a residual position-error estimation error of 0.19 cm.

AI.tldr: 该论文将无人机ISAC中的SAR成像表述为精确线性逆问题，提出基于扩散后验采样（DPS）的超分辨SAR框架，并联合运动补偿（MoCo）迭代优化以应对未知位置误差，实现高精度重建。
AI.motivation: 无人机SAR在低空ISAC中潜力巨大，但非理想轨迹与未知位置误差违反传统SAR假设，导致图像严重散焦，需要兼顾物理模型与数据先验的鲁棒成像方法。
AI.method: 将MIMO-OFDM波形的ISAC SAR成像建模为精确线性逆问题以刻画任意轨迹；采用预训练扩散模型作为数据驱动图像先验，结合DPS在推断中施加测量一致性约束，并加速推断；针对未知位置误差，提出DPS与MoCo联合迭代优化，使用DCT重参数化与由粗到细的频谱调度。
AI.result: 在多种轨迹下实现高精度重建与显著超分辨，即使半物理分辨率截断仍保持>21.3 dB PSNR；未知运动误差下联合DPS-MoCo达到23.65 dB PSNR，残余位置误差估计为0.19 cm。

title: Performance Evaluation of Mobile Target Sensing and Tracking Across Multiple Sensing Modes
summary: Moving extended-target sensing and tracking are studied in a beamformed PRS/OFDM ISAC framework. The target is modeled as a rigid cluster of scatterers whose Tx--target--Rx echoes coherently combine in a MIMO scattering channel. Delay, azimuth/elevation, and Doppler are estimated using PRS matched filtering with delay centroiding, single-cluster 2D-MUSIC, and FFT-based Doppler estimation, then used for independent localization and EKF-based tracking. The framework is evaluated in monostatic and bistatic modes under target-directed, receiver-directed, and omnidirectional beamforming. Simulation results show that EKF tracking reduces the aggregate 3D RMSE from 1.61 m to 1.38 m relative to independent localization. Target-directed beamforming substantially improves tracking accuracy, achieving 1.38 m RMSE compared with 5.91 m and 8.38 m for omnidirectional and receiver-directed beamforming, respectively. The results highlight the importance of target-aware beam management, delay-angle-Doppler fusion, and sensing geometry for mobile-target tracking in ISAC networks.

AI.tldr: 在波束赋形的PRS/OFDM ISAC框架下研究扩展目标感知与跟踪，通过时延-角度-多普勒估计结合EKF实现移动目标定位跟踪，并比较了单/双站与不同波束赋形策略的性能。
AI.motivation: 移动扩展目标的感知与跟踪是ISAC网络的关键问题，需评估波束管理与感知几何对跟踪精度的影响。
AI.method: 将目标建模为刚性散射体簇，MIMO散射信道中回波相干叠加；采用PRS匹配滤波加时延质心法、单簇2D-MUSIC测角、FFT多普勒估计，再进行独立定位与EKF跟踪，比较单/双站及目标指向/接收指向/全向波束赋形。
AI.result: EKF跟踪将聚合3D RMSE从1.61 m降至1.38 m；目标指向波束赋形达1.38 m，明显优于全向(5.91 m)与接收指向(8.38 m)。
AI.conclusion: 目标感知波束管理、时延-角度-多普勒融合及感知几何对ISAC网络移动目标跟踪至关重要。

title: DeepTelecom: A Differentiable Multimodal Framework for Channel Twinning in Dynamic Heterogeneous Wireless Environments
summary: Large-scale multimodal data are a key enabler for integrating large generative artificial intelligence models into wireless networks. However, existing wireless datasets offer limited support for heterogeneous environments, particularly in terms of reusable high-fidelity scenes, scalable differentiable ray tracing, and synchronized multimodal data. These limitations are more pronounced in mobile and aerial scenarios with time-varying environments and channels. To address these limitations, we propose DeepTelecom, a material-aware, high-fidelity multimodal channel dataset and reproducible generation framework for networks involving unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and reconfigurable intelligent surfaces. DeepTelecom refines coarse indoor/outdoor reconstructions and uses a large language model to map segmented surfaces to frequency-dependent electromagnetic parameters, yielding material-aware Level of Detail 3 digital twins. Then, a differentiable GPU-accelerated Sionna ray tracer simulates propagation across the sub-6 GHz/millimeter-wave/sub-terahertz bands, and specifically captures rotor-induced micro-Doppler signatures of stationary or moving UAVs at different pitch angles and translational velocities. The framework synchronously produces channel tensors, coverage maps, transmission videos, multi-view images, and weather-conditioned renderings, and supports differentiable material calibration from sparse channel anchors. The released dataset contains 10 material-aware indoor/outdoor scenes and 50,000 synchronized UAV samples; the framework supports scalable generation of additional data for user-defined scenes and system configurations. In 3D UAV localization, DeepTelecom reduces the 90th-percentile error from 31.05 m to 2.43 m compared with schemes considering only channel state information, demonstrating its significance for artificial-intelligence-enabled wireless systems.

AI.tldr: 提出DeepTelecom：面向UAV与RIS网络的材料感知高保真多模态信道数据集与可复现生成框架，基于LLM映射电磁参数、可微GPU光线追踪，生成信道张量、覆盖图、视频与图像，并支持稀疏信道锚点校准。
AI.motivation: 现有无线数据集难以支持异构环境，缺乏可复用高保真场景、可扩展可微光线追踪与同步多模态数据，在移动与空中场景下问题更突出。
AI.method: 融合粗重建精化、LLM驱动的材质-电磁参数映射得到LOD3数字孪生，用可微GPU加速Sionna光线追踪在sub-6GHz/毫米波/太赫兹频段仿真传播，捕获旋翼微多普勒，同步输出信道张量、覆盖图、传输视频、多视角图像及天气渲染，并支持稀疏信道锚点可微材质校准。
AI.result: 发布含10个材质感知室内外场景和50,000个同步UAV样本的数据集，支持自定义场景可扩展生成；3D UAV定位中90分位误差由31.05 m降至2.43 m。
AI.conclusion: DeepTelecom为AI赋能的无线系统提供可扩展的多模态信道数据与数字孪生生成能力，验证了材质感知与多模态融合在定位等任务中的价值。

title: Efficient Multimodal Beam Prediction for Real-World 6G UAV Communications via Image-Position-Synthetic Fusion
summary: Camera-based beam selection can reduce the need for exhaustive channel measurement in highly mobile millimeter-wave UAV links, but the complementary value of visual and position-derived representations and their behavior under modality degradation require further investigation. This paper develops a staged multimodal framework for current-beam prediction using real-world UAV measurements. The proposed 32-beam classifier combines an ImageNet-pretrained EfficientNet-B3 visual encoder with two deterministic position-derived representations: an explicit Geometric-Kinematic vector and a nonlinear synthetic feature basis constructed from position. The image and synthetic representations are fused first, followed by late fusion with the geometry representation. Experiments on DeepSense 6G Scenario 23 show that Image-Synthetic fusion achieves 86.92% Top-1, 99.03% Top-3, and 99.56% Top-5 accuracy, improving Top-1 performance by 2.64 percentage points over image-only inference and outperforming the 60.71% Top-1 accuracy of synthetic-only inference. Adding the Geometric-Kinematic branch yields the highest measured performance, reaching 87.14% Top-1, 99.12% Top-3, and 99.60% Top-5 accuracy. Controlled input interventions further demonstrate complementary behavior under visual degradation and strong sensitivity to severe synthetic-input corruption. Position-derived nonlinear features provide complementary information to visual context and improve current-beam prediction in the evaluated real-world UAV setting.

title: Limitations on Autoregressive Token Generation via Sequential Sampling
summary: We study autoregressive token generation through the notion of sequential samplers: A circuit that samples the next symbol only given the previous ones and possibly a small amount of state. We show that (1) a sequential sampler with $k$ bits of state can be simulated by a stateless one at a roughly $O(2^{k})$ size overhead; (2) efficient insertional sampling (Stern, Chan, Kiros, Uszkoreit, ICML 2019) is more powerful than efficient sequential sampling in any fixed order; (3) sequential samplers with small state cannot establish certain forms of covert cryptographic channels. Result (1), together with the pseudoentropy vs. sequential sampleability duality of Vadhan and Zheng (STOC 2012), characterizes efficient sequential sampleability with small state. Result (3) provides a potential safety mechanism against subliminal coordination among malicious LLM agents.
comment: In submission to ICLR 2027

AI.tldr: 该论文从计算复杂性角度研究自回归式 token 生成的"顺序采样器"，证明小状态采样器可被无状态采样器以指数开销模拟、插入式采样强于固定顺序顺序采样，并给出密码学隐蔽信道不可建立的条件。

title: Adaptive DOA Estimation With KL-Based Kernel Bandwidth Adaptation Under Impulsive Noise
summary: Direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation can degrade markedly in impulsive noise, where methods relying on Gaussian or second-order statistical assumptions are particularly susceptible to large-amplitude outliers. This paper develops an adaptive DOA estimator that employs Gaussian kernel weighting to attenuate the influence of large prediction errors while adjusting the kernel bandwidth online according to a Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence criterion. A sample-based approximation of the KL criterion yields a recursive bandwidth update that adapts the degree of outlier suppression to the observed error statistics rather than prescribing a fixed bandwidth a priori. The spatial-filter coefficients and kernel bandwidth are updated recursively, and the DOAs are recovered from the resulting spatial spectrum. Mean and mean-square analyses are developed under standard adaptive-filtering approximations to characterize the coefficient convergence and steady-state behavior. Simulation results under Gaussian-mixture impulsive noise demonstrate stable coefficient adaptation and improved DOA estimation accuracy over representative competing methods in several challenging operating regimes, with the most pronounced gains occurring at low-to-moderate signal-to-noise ratios. The results also indicate reduced sensitivity to the initial kernel bandwidth through online bandwidth adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种自适应DOA估计器，利用高斯核加权抑制脉冲噪声中的大误差，并通过KL散度准则在线调整核带宽，仿真显示在低中SNR下DOA精度优于对比方法。
AI.motivation: 脉冲噪声下依赖高斯或二阶统计假设的DOA估计方法易受大幅值离群点影响，性能显著退化，需要一种能自适应抑制离群点的鲁棒估计器。
AI.method: 采用高斯核加权削弱大预测误差的影响，基于KL散度准则的样本近似推导递归带宽更新，空间滤波器系数与核带宽联合递归更新，并从空间谱中恢复DOA；同时给出均值与均方收敛性分析。

title: Optimal Receive Design on the Observation Axis for RSMA Satellite-UAV Downlinks
summary: A receiver can change its observation state while the physical signal remains the same. In rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) downlinks, this distinction separates receive-beam design and phase-reference transport from the motion of the satellite--UAV line of sight. We formulate receive optimization within the physical--observation dual-axis (PODA) structure and obtain three complementary results. For a known line-of-sight response and positive-definite receiver-noise covariance, a noise-weighted matched combiner simultaneously maximizes every decoding SINR and the minimum user rate. Under directional uncertainty, the principal eigenvector of the conditional response covariance globally maximizes mean array gain; for a Gaussian directional model, an equal-amplitude receiver is optimized by steering towards the conditional mean. Mean rate requires a different objective. We prove that the RSMA common-rate water level is jointly concave in the users' receive gains and derive a semidefinite relaxation with a computable global upper bound. A feasible rank-one beam can therefore be compared directly with the optimum of the finite-scenario problem. We also derive a precision-weighted linear predictor that suppresses uncertain physical-velocity estimates after observation-frame transport. Paired dynamic simulations reduce direction-cosine RMSE by 51.29\% relative to unrestricted nine-point extrapolation. In a separate uncertainty experiment, direct rate optimization increases mean minimum spectral efficiency from 0.32425 to 0.41712 bit/s/Hz, an improvement of 28.64\%; the corresponding design objective is within $2.28\times10^{-4}$ bit/s/Hz of a global upper bound. The phase-transport equation fixes a coherent representative of each optimal beam without changing its gain.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出物理-观测双轴(PODA)框架，用于RSMA星地-无人机下行链路的接收波束优化与相位参考传输，给出匹配合并、协方差主特征波束、共速率注水凹性及半定松弛全局上界等结果，并含预测器与动态仿真验证。

AI.method: 构建PODA结构；对已知视距响应与正定噪声协方差推导噪声加权匹配合并器；对方向不确定性用条件响应协方差主特征向量最大化平均阵列增益，并在高斯方向模型下用条件均值指向；证明RSMA共速率的注水水位对接收增益联合凹，给出半定松弛与可计算全局上界；推导精度加权线性预测器以抑制速度估计不确定性。

AI.conclusion: PODA为RSMA下行接收优化提供了可证明最优性与全局上界保证的统一框架，兼顾方向不确定性、速率最优性与运动不确定性抑制，并给出可实施的波束与相位参考设计。

title: UL-Assisted Parametric CSI Feedback and Prediction for FDD Systems
summary: In frequency-division duplex (FDD) systems, the uplink (UL) and downlink (DL) channels are not fully reciprocal. Therefore, DL channel state information (CSI) estimated by each user equipment (UE) must be fed back to the base station (BS). However, because the channel varies between CSI acquisition and utilization, the feedback CSI may become outdated before it is used at the BS. To address this challenge, this paper proposes an UL-assisted parametric CSI feedback and prediction scheme for multi-user FDD systems with time-varying channel parameters. By exploiting the partial reciprocity between the UL and DL channel parameters, the BS first estimates the UL channel parameters from the sounding reference signals (SRSs) transmitted by the UEs. The BS then broadcasts DL pilots, allowing each UE to obtain observations containing information about its current DL channel. Instead of explicitly estimating the DL channel from these observations, each UE directly encodes them into feedback symbols and transmits the symbols to the BS. The BS decoder combines the feedback symbols with the partially reciprocal UL parameters to predict the future DL channel parameters. Finally, the corresponding DL channel matrix is synthesized from the predicted parameters using an explicit physical channel model. Simulation results on Sionna ray tracing (RT) dataset show that the proposed scheme outperforms the considered baselines in terms of channel prediction performance over different signal-to-noise ratios and prediction lengths.
comment: The paper is accepeted in GlobeCom 2026

AI.tldr: 提出一种上行辅助的参数化CSI反馈与预测方案：BS从SRS估计UL信道参数，UE将DL导频观测直接编码为反馈符号，BS结合部分互易的UL参数预测未来DL信道参数并合成信道矩阵。在Sionna RT数据集上，该方案在不同SNR和预测长度下优于基线。
AI.motivation: FDD系统中上下行信道不完全互易，DL CSI须由UE反馈给BS；但信道在CSI获取与使用之间发生变化，导致反馈CSI过时，需在反馈中同时实现预测以缓解时延与开销问题。

AI.conclusion: 结合部分互易参数化建模与直接编码反馈，可在有限反馈与低复杂度条件下提升时变FDD多用户系统的DL信道预测精度，为CSI反馈与预测一体化设计提供可行路径。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接围绕FDD CSI反馈与信道预测，利用部分互易和参数化物理模型实现低开销反馈与预测，契合CSI反馈/压缩与信道重建方向；但AI学习成分较弱，参数估计与合成仍偏传统信号处理。

title: Sum Rate Maximization for Practical RIS-Enhanced Rate-Splitting Multiple Access Systems
summary: Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) combined with rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) provide a promising solution for improving the spectral efficiency (SE) of sixth-generation (6G) communication systems. However, most existing studies neglect the practical coupling between the RIS phase shift and amplitude, which may cause phase-shift mismatch and significant performance loss. In this paper, we investigate the multiuser sum-rate maximization problem for practical RIS-enhanced RSMA systems considering amplitude-phase coupling. To address the resulting non-convex problem, an effective variable separation algorithm is proposed. The proposed algorithm is compatible with RIS reflecting optimization under the continuous phase shift or any amplitude-phase coupling relationship and can also be directly extended to practical RIS-enhanced NOMA and OMA systems. Simulation results demonstrate performance gain of over 190\% compared with the ideal-RIS-based benchmark, while the proposed RSMA scheme significantly outperforms the corresponding NOMA and OMA schemes.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究实际RIS存在幅度-相位耦合时的多用户和速率最大化问题，提出变量分离算法进行RIS反射优化，并兼容RSMA/NOMA/OMA系统。
AI.motivation: 现有RIS-RSMA研究多忽略RIS相位与幅度的实际耦合，导致相位失配与性能损失。
AI.method: 针对非凸和速率最大化问题，提出变量分离算法，适用于任意幅度-相位耦合关系与连续相移。

title: A QoE-Driven Framework for O-RAN Network Slicing Based on Empirical Multi-User VR Traffic Modelling
summary: Virtual Reality (VR) requires strict Quality-of-Experience (QoE) guarantees, making radio resource management harder. Static slice allocations are wasteful, while dynamic approaches often rely on heuristic penalty functions lacking an empirical basis. We introduce a QoE-driven network-slicing framework for Open RAN in which resource allocation is guided by empirically derived multi-user VR traffic statistics. Closed-form n-fold convolutions model the aggregate data rate and inter-arrival time of n concurrent users, validated empirically for up to four. The fitted data-rate cumulative distribution function is checked against the measured throughput to give a percentile-based satisfaction indicator; the inter-arrival law sets the slice targets. A near-real-time RIC xApp closes a loop over the E2SM-KPM and E2SM-RC interfaces to apply slice-level Physical Resource Block (PRB) quotas. On an over-the-air testbed it reclaims up to 41% of the cell's committed PRBs from a greedy neighbouring slice while never reducing the protected VR slice. An analytical study then estimates the PRB demand and per-user QoE across user counts and channel qualities, giving the admission boundary beyond which the target QoE is unattainable. A controlled comparison further shows that a fixed-rate synthetic load overstates the VR slice's PRB footprint by 68%, showing the necessity of data-driven slice dimensioning.

title: Point-Supervised Visual Learning for GNSS Measurement Quality Assessment
summary: Multipath and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) propagation degrade global navigation satellite system (GNSS) positioning accuracy in urban environments. Although fisheye sky segmentation identifies obstructions along satellite directions, binary visibility does not fully characterize observation quality. This study proposes a point-supervised visual framework that predicts GNSS observation faults from fisheye images using supervision derived from GNSS observations. During offline labeling, a vision-assisted differential GNSS procedure selects multiple reference satellites based on sky visibility and elevation constraints. Double-difference pseudorange residuals automatically generate fault labels and sample importance weights at satellite projection locations. A residual-weighted loss is computed only at valid labeled points, enabling learning from sparse supervision without manual pixelwise fault annotations. The trained network generates dense fault probability maps, which are sampled at satellite projection locations to weight observations in weighted least squares positioning, reducing the influence of potentially faulty observations. The framework is evaluated using U-Net, DeepLabv3+, DINOv3, and SAM3 on urban vehicle data collected on a different day from the training data. All four models reduce horizontal root mean square error (RMSE) by 29.51% to 36.07% compared with SAM binary sky segmentation, with U-Net achieving the lowest RMSE of 0.78 m. The framework also provides positioning solutions during some intervals when the segmentation baseline fails. These results demonstrate the framework's generalization ability and show that GNSS-derived point supervision enables fisheye images to provide observation quality information beyond binary sky visibility, supporting GNSS fault detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种点监督的视觉框架，利用GNSS观测自动生成故障标签与样本权重，从鱼眼图像预测GNSS观测故障概率图，并用其加权最小二乘定位，在城市场景中将水平RMSE降低约30%–36%。

AI.method: 离线阶段用视觉辅助差分GNSS按天空可见性与高度角选取多颗参考卫星，由双差伪距残差在卫星投影位置自动生成故障标签与重要性权重；训练时仅在有效标注点计算残差加权损失，实现稀疏监督学习；推理时网络输出稠密故障概率图，在卫星投影处采样以加权最小二乘定位。评估使用U-Net、DeepLabv3+、DINOv3与SAM3。

title: MSE Minimization for Movable Antenna Enhanced Wireless Sensing via Array Geometry Optimization
summary: This paper develops adaptive movable-antenna (MA) array structures to enhance wireless sensing performance under arbitrary SNR conditions, using the AoA estimation MSE as the sensing metric. Due to the presence of strong sidelobes in the ambiguity function of sparse MA arrays, the classical CRB of AoA estimation MSE fails to characterize the true MSE in the low and medium SNR regimes, rendering CRB-optimized antenna position vector designs suboptimal for MA-enabled sensing. We derive a deterministic MSE approximation that captures the local estimation error within the mainlobe of the ambiguity function and the outlier error induced by sidelobes, providing a tractable and accurate optimization objective. We then propose three adaptive MA structures that are tailored to different hardware and computational requirements. For systems with fully independent motors, a movable free array is optimized by a two-stage greedy algorithm, which approaches the performance of the globally optimal exhaustive search but with lower computational complexity. Halving the required motors, a movable nested array fixes the dense inner subarray and adjusts only the outer-subarray spacing, reducing the optimization to a one-dimensional search. As the most hardware-efficient design, a movable twin array is proposed to adjust the inter-subarray spacing only with a single motor, while still achieving significant MSE reduction over fixed array geometries. Numerical results show that the derived approximation closely matches the true MSE compared with existing performance bounds, and that the proposed structures outperform the CRB-optimized designs by orders of magnitude in MSE across the tested low-to-medium SNR range. Moreover, it reveals that in the low-SNR regime, APV reconfiguration is more effective for improving estimation accuracy than simply increasing the number of fixed antennas.

title: Optimally Setting RMS Energy Bands for Detecting Oscillations
summary: Oscillation monitors have root-mean-square (RMS) energy detectors at their core. These detect oscillation in a predefined frequency band by comparing the signal power in that band with a threshold (usually set empirically). A key design decision is the choice of frequency bands. Traditionally, for monitoring the stability of wide-area electromechanical modes, finer bands were set below 1 Hz, while higher frequencies were covered by wider bands. However, this approach can yield poor detection in modern power systems with fast and largely unknown local dynamics. This letter proposes an algorithm to set frequency bands from the ambient noise spectrum to maximize the average detection performance.

title: CKM-Based Predictive Beamforming for Energy-Efficient Mobile Tracking in ISCAP System
summary: This paper proposes a channel-knowledge-map (CKM)-based predictive beamforming framework for integrated sensing, communication, and powering (ISCAP) of a mobile energy-constrained node in non-line-of-sight (NLoS) multipath environments. The CKM provides location-dependent channel information for both predictive beamforming and EKF-based tracking, while resolved path parameters estimated from the sensing echoes are used as observations. Based on the predicted node location, the transmit covariance and power-splitting ratio are jointly optimized to maximize wireless power-transfer efficiency subject to communication, sensing, transmit-power, and tracking-quality constraints. A finite-battery model and an adaptive inter-frame energy-management policy are further introduced to balance decoding energy consumption and battery preservation. The resulting non-convex fractional problem is solved using Dinkelbach's method, alternating optimization, and semidefinite relaxation. Numerical results show that the proposed framework maintains reliable tracking, satisfies the prescribed position-uncertainty requirement, achieves near-oracle wireless power-transfer performance after the initial tracking transient, and preserves more battery energy while meeting the required communication quality of service.

title: UAV-Mounted Hybrid RIS-Assisted ISAC-RSMA: Performance Analysis with Imperfect CSI and SIC
summary: In integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems, strict sensing requirements can substantially constrain the transmit power available for communication. A hybrid reconfigurable intelligent surface (HRIS) with passive reflection and active amplification capabilities mounted on an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) can enhance coverage and strengthen communication links in such power-limited regimes. Meanwhile, rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) provides an effective transmission strategy for managing inter-user interference, particularly in dense multiuser wireless scenarios. Motivated by this, we analyze the performance of a UAV-mounted HRIS-assisted monostatic ISAC system employing RSMA scheme. We consider the imperfections in the channel state information and successive interference cancellation in the RSMA, which are inevitable in practical system implementations. We then derive highly accurate expressions for outage probability, ergodic rate, and throughput to evaluate communication performance over Nakagami-$m$ fading channels. These expressions reveal key insights into the diversity order and coding gain of the system in the high signal-to-noise ratio regime. To characterize the sensing performance, we derive expressions for the probability of detection, the probability of false alarm, and the Cramér-Rao lower bound. Numerical results validate the theoretical findings and highlight the performance gains of the proposed system over conventional multiple-access schemes and RIS-based systems.

AI.method: 针对UAV-HRIS辅助单站ISAC+RSMA系统，考虑CSI与SIC不完美，在Nakagami-m衰落信道下推导中断概率、遍历速率、吞吐量、检测概率、虚警概率及CRLB的解析表达式，并进行数值验证。

title: Physics-Informed Unsupervised Learning for Reliable Beamforming in Cluttered MIMO-ISAC
summary: In this paper, we consider joint beamforming and power allocation for a mobile multiuser MIMO integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) network with clutter, residual self-interference, and outdated channel state information, under per-user rate and sensing signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) constraints that must hold on every realization. The design must be recomputed every block, and distant or weak targets can make the sensing constraint unmeetable. We propose a physics-informed unsupervised learning (PI-UnSL) network that corrects the analytical design, meets the power and norm constraints exactly by construction, and is conditioned on closed-form interference statistics, spanning the whole tradeoff in one pass. We derive a closed-form sensing SINR at the interference-aware combiner, yielding a necessary range-radar-cross-section-power condition and a priority-independent analytic violation floor, so the problem is intermittently infeasible. We then show that a dual targeting below the attainable floor has no fixed point, and calibrate the label-free objective against the measured floor. Numerical results confirm the floor and the bounded calibrated dual, and show that PI-UnSL substantially raises per-realization joint quality of service over the closed-form baseline, delivers more rate than time-division ISAC at matched detection over most of the tradeoff, and exceeds the reliability of an uncalibrated alternating-optimization solver at a fraction of its latency. More broadly, the physical knowledge given to the network, not its architecture, makes such problems learnable without labels: five architectures fail alike from scratch and perform alike when started from the closed-form design and conditioned on its interference statistics.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对含杂波、残余自干扰和过时CSI的移动多用户MIMO ISAC网络，提出物理信息驱动的无监督学习(PI-UnSL)网络，实现联合波束成形与功率分配，并推导闭式感知SINR及可行性条件。
AI.motivation: 在移动多用户MIMO ISAC网络中，需在每用户速率与感知SINR的逐实现约束下联合设计波束成形和功率分配，但过时CSI、残留自干扰和弱目标会导致问题间歇性不可行，且需每块重算，传统交替优化时延高且可靠性不足，因此需要一种低时延、可靠且能覆盖整个权衡的方法。
AI.method: 推导干扰感知合并器下的闭式感知SINR，给出必要的距离-雷达截面积-功率条件与优先级无关的解析违约下界；证明低于可达下界的对偶目标无不动点，并据此校准无标签目标；提出PI-UnSL网络，通过构造精确满足功率与范数约束，并以闭式干扰统计为条件修正解析设计。

AI.conclusion: 在该ISAC设计中，使问题可学习的关键是注入网络的物理知识（闭式设计初始化与干扰统计条件），而非网络架构本身；物理信息驱动的无监督学习可实现无需标签、低时延且高可靠的联合波束成形与功率分配。

title: CSI-Aging-Aware Functional Split Optimization and KAN-LSTM Prediction for Open-RAN NTN
summary: In this paper, we study functional-split selection for an Open radio access network (RAN) deployed as a non-terrestrial network (NTN), in which a low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellite hosts the radio unit, so that each candidate split (7.2x, 6, 2) places the RAN at a distinct point of the transparent-to-regenerative axis. We capture the space-ground geometry exactly through an instantaneous link plane, which yields closed-form slant range, elevation, delay, and Doppler for an inclined orbit and a rotating Earth. On this geometry we derive the received-SNR density of the elevation-driven LOS/NLOS mixture channel and, through a split-dependent channel state information (CSI) aging mechanism, an uncoded bit-error-rate (BER) law for each split, establishing that what separates the splits is the freshness of the CSI each brings to its adaptation loops: a loop closed on the ground pays the feeder round-trip and incurs an aging-induced error floor. We formulate split selection as a prefer-centralized feasibility problem over reliability, aging, and fronthaul-capacity constraints, and we show that its exact solution is a closed-form region rule in four state coordinates, validated against exhaustive enumeration without a single mismatch. Because this solution is reactive whereas a split change must be initiated ahead of time, we propose a compact Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN)-LSTM, sized for an edge xApp/rApp, that predicts the split schedule seconds ahead; we show that it attains high schedule accuracy at a sub-percent BER-violation probability and delivers nearly all of the ground-truth policy's goodput, outperforming naive and reactive baselines.

title: Effective DoF Collapse in Sparse Near-Field Beamforming: A Block-Rank-1 Mechanism
summary: Sparse near-field arrays phase-cohere $M$ widely separated sub-arrays of $N$ elements and underpin distributed MIMO, satellite formations, and integrated sensing and communication. We show that their interference suppression over a protected region is set by coherence within a single sub-array rather than by the span of the formation: the effective rank of the region covariance can collapse from $MN$ to $M$. Two independent arguments establish this. For canonical line and disk regions each diagonal covariance block is exactly a classical concentration operator, which supplies sharp per-block rank thresholds and makes fewer than one spatial degree of freedom per sub-array a conservative design rule; an orthogonal decomposition with eigenvalue interlacing gives a nonasymptotic sufficient condition that assumes nothing about the coupling between platforms. The consequences are covariance-side and beamformer-independent: the unloaded Capon functional upper-bounds worst-case signal-to-interference ratio, while its regularized counterpart scales very differently for angularly separated and for in-cone targets. An eight-satellite LEO study validates the theory, including realized worst-case SIR.

title: Load Disaggregation under Incomplete Inventory with Structured Unclaimed Demand
summary: An incomplete inventory creates a specific attribution ambiguity in load disaggregation: unclaimed demand can offset changes in claimed loads without altering meter reconstruction. We study how the allowed target and nuisance trajectories govern this ambiguity. A bounded ordered Markov chain represents unclaimed demand, while an unweighted acceptor removes commissioning-inconsistent paths from one target without reweighting surviving paths; exact factorial MAP jointly decodes all paths. At two fully instrumented commercial buildings, restricting exterior-lighting support improves agreement on the count of rooftop compressors although no compressor chain is constrained; the gain depends on the nuisance representation. A synthetic experiment identifies the boundary: the effect persists under support-preserving changes but reverses when the true path violates commissioned support or the commissioned level is miscalibrated. Attribution therefore depends on joint target-nuisance path geometry, not reconstruction error alone.

title: Entropy/Length Profile Bounds for the Conversion of (Non)linear Codes in the Merge Regime
summary: Code conversion changes the parameters of encoded data while avoiding complete decoding and re-encoding. Existing general bounds largely rely on the algebraic structure of linear codes. This paper develops an information-theoretic framework for nonlinear code conversion in the merge regime. Using the entropy/length profile (ELP), we derive upper bounds on the number of unchanged symbols and lower bounds on the number of read symbols for arbitrary $(n,M)_q$ codes, without assuming linearity or requiring $\log_q M$ to be an integer. We also obtain joint bounds for multiple initial codes and consequences involving minimum distance. For linear codes, the proposed bounds reduce to the corresponding generalized Hamming weight (GHW) bounds. The construction based on Hamming codes converts Hamming codes of redundancy two into a Hamming code of any larger redundancy and simultaneously attains the general bounds on unchanged and read symbols. The construction based on quasigroups shows that new bounds remain tight for genuinely nonlinear codes of nonintegral dimension and at a nonintegral entropy threshold, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first construction of convertible codes for nonlinear codes.

title: Structure-Exploiting ADMM for Low-Complexity Finite-Blocklength Beamforming in Cellular IoT Networks
summary: Ultra-reliable and low-latency communication (URLLC) is essential for mission-critical cellular Internet of Things (IoT) applications requiring reliable short-packet transmission and efficient radio-resource allocation. However, finite-blocklength (FBL)-aware beamforming becomes computationally demanding as the numbers of users and antennas increase. Existing successive convex approximation (SCA) methods typically rely on general-purpose convex solvers without exploiting the structure of the resulting beamforming problem. This paper develops a structure-exploiting consensus alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) framework for low-complexity FBL-aware beamforming in downlink multi-user multiple-input single-output (MU-MISO) cellular IoT networks. The FBL sum rate is maximized subject to transmit-power and per-user minimum-rate constraints. Each SCA iteration yields a convex quadratically constrained quadratic program (QCQP), reformulated into an equivalent consensus problem. For an M-antenna base station serving N IoT nodes, the global update exploits Kronecker structure to replace an MN-by-MN factorization with a shared M-by-M factorization, while rank-one channel matrices enable low-complexity local projections. CVX-SCA serves as a general-purpose benchmark, whereas standard ADMM-SCA isolates the gains from structural exploitation. Numerical results demonstrate close agreement with CVX-SCA in objective value, feasibility, and convergence. Under user scaling, the proposed method achieves more than 4-fold end-to-end speedup over CVX-SCA and approximately 6-fold per-iteration speedup over standard ADMM-SCA, demonstrating its computational efficiency for cellular IoT resource allocation.

title: CAPA Beamforming for Extended-Target ISAC: Finite-Rank Solution Structure and Adaptive Electromagnetic-Mode Enrichment
summary: Continuous-aperture arrays (CAPAs) provide a new electromagnetic transmission paradigm by directly controlling the source-current distribution over a continuous radiating aperture. This paper studies CAPA-enabled integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) with spatially extended sensing targets, for which the electromagnetic response over each target region is characterized by an aperture-to-region operator. Unlike point-target models, the resulting illumination operator may have infinite rank, precluding a priori finite-dimensional reduction of the transmit design. We formulate the joint communication and target-illumination beamforming problem in the continuous electromagnetic domain and develop an operator semidefinite relaxation (SDR). A key structural result is that the optimal transmit covariance operators remain finite rank even when the aggregate illumination operator has infinite rank. We further establish the tightness of the operator SDR and provide a constructive rank-one recovery of the information beamformers. Since the finite electromagnetic subspace supporting the optimum is generally unknown, we develop a dual-slack-driven adaptive mode-enrichment method that discovers the required modes from the full-space optimality conditions. The dual-slack violation simultaneously identifies missing modes and yields a computable certificate of the remaining full-space optimality gap. Global convergence of the enrichment sequence to the full-space optimum is established. Numerical results validate the finite-rank optimal structure and show that the proposed method approaches the full-space optimum with substantially fewer electromagnetic modes than truncated-SVD and spatial-Fourier representations.

title: Rydberg Atomic Quantum Receivers for OFDM Systems: An Atomic-Comb Design
summary: Rydberg atomic quantum receivers (RAQR) exhibit exceptional sensitivity to radio-frequency (RF) signals, positioning them as promising candidates for next-generation wireless systems. Extending their capabilities to orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM), however, requires atomic responses that go beyond broadband reception and are tailored to the structured interference of multicarrier signals. To bridge this gap, we develop an atomic-comb Rydberg receiver based on six-wave mixing (SWM) transduction. In particular, injecting a multi-tone local oscillator (LO) into the RAQR generates frequency-shifted replicas of the intrinsic SWM response. By subtly tuning the amplitude and phase of each LO tone, constructive and destructive interference can be selectively induced to preserve desired response components while attenuating harmful frequency offsets. Furthermore, we harness the response-reshaping capability of the proposed atomic comb to proactively mitigate OFDM interference. More explicitly, by exploiting the discrete difference-frequency structure of both carrier-frequency-offset (CFO)-induced and phase-noise (PN)-induced inter-carrier interference (ICI), we optimize the atomic-comb response to suppress dominant ICI components directly. We further reveal an intrinsic coupling between spectral shaping and the time-domain effective channel memory, motivating a joint optimization of both ICI and inter-symbol interference (ISI), which simultaneously suppresses inter-carrier leakage and post-cyclic-prefix (CP) tail energy. Extensive simulation results validate our atomic-comb design, unveiling that the proposed atomic comb can effectively reshape the receiver response over the OFDM, while mitigating ICI, shortening the effective channel memory, and substantially lowering CP overhead.

title: New Minimum Storage Regenerating Codes With Small Sub-packetization Levels for All Admissible Repair Degrees
summary: In this paper, {we propose a new family of $(n, k)$ Minimum Storage Regenerating (MSR) codes} for distributed storage systems. By structuring the parity-check matrix as a block Vandermonde matrix composed of diagonal matrices and generalized permutation matrices, the proposed code achieves a sub-packetization level of $N = (d-k+1)^{\lceil\frac{n}{2}\rceil}$ and supports any repair degree $k+1\le d<n$. A key innovation of the new construction lies in relaxing the strict commutativity condition previously required for the building blocks in the parity-check matrices of Ye-Barg codes. We introduce a novel proof technique to establish the MDS property without relying on full commutativity, thereby generalizing the applicability of block Vandermonde matrices and enriching the family of Ye-Barg codes. Additionally, the sparsity of the parity-check matrix enhances encoding and decoding efficiency by reducing computational complexity. This work provides new insights into the construction of MSR codes.

title: Radio Echo Representation Learning for Semantic Sensing in Multi-Modal ISAC Systems
summary: Semantic sensing extends integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) beyond physical parameter estimation by exploiting task-oriented representations from radio echoes. Nevertheless, existing multimodal sensing remains largely limited to vision-assisted radio physical parameter estimation or typically processes the visual and radio modalities separately, leaving radio representations underutilized for visual task enhancement. Feature-level fusion enables closer cross-modal interaction, while echo interference complicates the learning of user-specific radio representations and its semantic consistency with the visual entities. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a multimodal semantic sensing framework for orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM)-ISAC systems. We propose a radio encoder to learn radio representations oriented toward visual localization from superimposed pilot echoes, together with Variational Radio-Visual Grounding (VRVG) to promote semantic consistency between the learned radio representations and visual spatial features. The radio representations are then formulated as semantic probes to highlight the corresponding entities in the visual scene through cross-modal fusion. Experiments using real-world RCooper dataset show that the resulting synergistic radio-visual embeddings enable accurate radio-visual user matching and significantly improve both user-specific visual localization and physical parameter estimation performance. The results substantiate the benefits of radio representation learning and semantically consistent fusion for multimodal semantic sensing.

title: An Arduino Giga-Based Multi-Frequency Electrical Impedance Tomography System for Electrolyte Media: Hardware Design, Statistical Voltage Analysis, and System Performance Evaluation
summary: Multi-frequency electrical impedance tomography (EIT) often requires specialized hardware. This challenge is especially pronounced in biomedical applications. We developed a 16-electrode EIT system using an Arduino GIGA R1 WiFi for generation and acquisition, with a discrete current source, three analog multiplexers, and basic signal conditioning. Dual cores separate waveform timing from switching and acquisition. A 3D-printed tank with silver-wire electrodes was tested at 11 frequencies (1-180 kHz). Across the 10-180 kHz analysis band, median repeat-frame signal-to-noise ratio was 48 dB, acquisition rate was ~0.18 frames/s per frequency (~60 s per sweep), and cross-session baseline drift was ~6%. KCl phantoms contained an insulating ABS cylinder or KCl-filled dialysis bags (0.001-1.0 M) spanning positive and negative conductivity contrasts. Boundary voltages were analyzed without reconstruction to estimate inclusion position, contrast polarity, and relative magnitude. Leave-one-session-out matching located ABS inclusions in 29/30 runs at 160 kHz (87-97% across the band; chance 33%). For dialysis bags, polarity was correctly identified in all 36 nonzero-contrast runs. Signed voltage projections correlated with the cylindrical contrast factor (R^2=0.68 across runs; R^2=0.89 for the aggregate fit). Concentration was ordered (Spearman rho=0.85), despite saturation above ~10-fold contrast. Bag position accuracy ranged from 6/6 at the highest contrasts to 2/6 at matched conductivity. The matched-conductivity bag produced a ~1.7% RMS perturbation against 0.4-0.6% repeat-frame variability. These results demonstrate that microcontroller-based multi-frequency EIT can support selected detection and identification tasks through direct boundary-voltage analysis, supporting future studies of muscle electrochemistry.

title: Wyner's Common Information and the Common Entropy are NP-Hard to Compute
summary: Wyner's common information $J(p)$ and the common entropy $G(p)$ of a pair of random variables $(X,Y)$ with finite ranges and joint distribution $p$ are both defined by an optimization over the auxiliary random variables $W$ that make $X$ and $Y$ conditionally independent: $J(p)$ is the infimum of the mutual information $I(X,Y;W)$, and $G(p)$ is the infimum of the entropy $H(W)$. We prove that both quantities are NP-hard to compute. For Wyner's common information, deciding whether $J(p)$ is strictly smaller than a given integer $r$ is NP-hard, and the problem is NP-complete on tables that are uniform on their support and have the same number of positive entries in every row. The reduction is from Maximum Edge Biclique and rests on an exact criterion, in terms of rectangles in the support of $p$, for improving on the auxiliary $W=X$; every yes-instance satisfies $J(p)<r-1/(4N^2)$ and every no-instance satisfies $J(p)=r$, where $N$ is the number of positive entries of $p$. For the common entropy, deciding whether $G(p)\le r$ for a rational number $r$ is NP-hard, even for tables with at most four nonzero entries in each row, all taking one of two values. The reduction is from exact cover by $3$-sets and rests on a majorization property of the masses of the nonnegative rank-one decompositions of $p$, combined with a quantitative form of the Schur concavity of entropy. In both cases the separation between yes- and no-instances is inverse-polynomial in the size of $p$, so that approximating $J(p)$ or $G(p)$ within a suitable inverse-polynomial additive error is also NP-hard. The two mechanisms are genuinely different: we exhibit a table on which a large rectangle in the support lowers $J$ below the threshold of our first reduction while leaving $G$ on it.

title: Eunoia: Toward Application-Transparent, Scalable GPU Sharing in AI-RAN
summary: The AI-RAN paradigm makes the next-generation cellular network more versatile by co-locating AI and RAN workloads on the same commodity hardware. While the GPU is a promising platform for AI-RAN realization, a generic concurrent AI application interferes with the latency-sensitive RAN on GPU compute resources. In this paper, we propose Eunoia, a dynamic real-time AI-RAN GPU scheduler that is transparent to both AI applications and the RAN workload and operates at the granularity level of the RAN slot. We deploy Eunoia onto NVIDIA Aerial AI-RAN and evaluate Eunoia on both an over-the-air 5G private network and an emulated multi-cell network. We demonstrate that in a 27-cell AI-RAN, Eunoia keeps the RAN uplink P99 latency under 3 ms while delivering higher AI performance than other RAN-safe static partitioning methods.

AI.tldr: 提出Eunoia，一种面向AI-RAN的GPU实时调度器，以RAN时隙为粒度动态协调AI与RAN计算资源，在NVIDIA Aerial平台上实现低时延RAN与高AI性能的共存。

AI.method: 设计Eunoia动态实时GPU调度器，以RAN时隙（slot）为粒度进行资源调度，对AI应用与RAN负载均保持透明，并部署于NVIDIA Aerial AI-RAN平台。

title: Insdel Reed-Solomon Decoding Algorithms up to the Half-Singleton Bound
summary: In this paper, we focus on decoding optimal Reed-Solomon codes of dimension two for insdel errors up to the half-Singleton bound. We present a decoding algorithm for the general insertion-and-deletion scenario with a time complexity smaller than brute-force decoding. Our algorithm corrects insdel errors up to the half-Singleton bound, which exceeds the scope of existing methods. Additionally, for the special cases of insertion-only and deletion-only insdel error patterns, we present two different algorithms with a time complexity smaller than our general algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文研究维度为2的Reed-Solomon码在插入删除(insdel)错误下、达到半Singleton界的译码算法，提出时间复杂度低于暴力译码的通用算法，并针对纯插入与纯删除场景给出更快的特例算法。
AI.motivation: 插入删除信道下的纠错码译码是编码理论中的难点，现有方法难以达到半Singleton界；作者希望在更大的纠错范围内实现高效译码。
AI.method: 针对维度为2的Reed-Solomon码设计通用insdel译码算法，纠正能力达到半Singleton界，复杂度低于暴力搜索；并对纯插入、纯删除两种特殊错误模式分别设计复杂度更低的两套算法。

title: An Upper Bound to the Undetected Error Exponent with Erasure Decoding at Positive Rates
summary: We study the undetected-error exponent of discrete memoryless channels with erasure decoding. Assuming that the undetected-error and erasure probabilities vanish, we derive an upper bound on the undetected-error exponent at positive rates. The bound uses Somekh-Baruch's genie-aided argument where an auxiliary output provides the decoder with a list of codewords. It recovers Telatar's tight rate-zero converse and is at least as tight as the straight-line bound. A numerical example shows that the improvement over the straight-line bound can be strict.

AI.tldr: 研究带擦除译码的离散无记忆信道的未检测错误指数，利用精灵辅助（genie-aided）列表译码论证给出正速率下的上界。
AI.motivation: 刻画在未检测错误概率与擦除概率同时趋于零时，正速率下未检测错误指数能达到的极限，改进已有直线界并统一Telatar的零速率紧致逆定理。
AI.method: 采用Somekh-Baruch的genie-aided论证：引入辅助输出向译码器提供码字列表，据此推导未检测错误指数的上界，并与直线界及Telatar的零速率逆定理比较；给出数值算例。
AI.result: 所得上界可恢复Telatar的紧致零速率逆定理，且不松于直线界；数值例子表明该界对直线界的改进可以是严格的。
AI.conclusion: 该界为擦除译码下未检测错误指数提供了更紧的刻画，是信道编码可靠性理论（错误指数/逆定理）层面的结果，与CSI获取、信道估计或无线物理层AI无直接关联。

title: Universal Decoding for Unequal Error Protection
summary: We study universal unequal error protection of a single special message over discrete memoryless channels. We construct a sequence of codes with a decoding rule that does not depend on the channel transition law. We derive an achievable error exponent for the special message while ensuring reliable decoding of the ordinary messages. The resulting exponent strictly improves on the natural equal-error-protection random-coding baseline and remains positive as the rate approaches capacity. For symmetric channels, it converges to the optimal red-alert exponent at capacity.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究离散无记忆信道上单个特殊消息的通用不等错误保护（UEP），构造了不依赖信道转移概率的解码规则码序列，推导了特殊消息的可达错误指数，并证明其严格优于等错误保护随机编码基线，在速率趋近容量时仍保持正值；对对称信道，该指数在容量处收敛到最优"红色警报"指数。

title: A Multi-View Low-Latency Direction-Sensing for Low-Altitude Network via a Multi-Armed Array
summary: Due to the directional antenna pattern, the received signal power decreases when the target deviates from the array boresight, degrading direction-sensing accuracy. Although rotatable arrays can alleviate this problem, repeated array rotations will induce an incremental long sensing latency. To break the dilemma of harvesting the directive gain from element and making a low-latency sensing, a multi-armed array comprising multiple subarrays with different orientations is proposed to provide wide spatial coverage encompassing low-altitude and terrestrial regions while enabling multi-view direction sensing. However, the different views lead to different direction-sensing accuracies. To fully exploit the complementary information from multiple views, two fusion methods, called SNR-weighted fusion and logistic-weighted fusion, are developed. The former directly assigns fusion weights according to the estimated received SNRs, whereas the latter employs an exponential SNR mapping to further emphasize high-SNR subarrays. Furthermore, the Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRLB) is derived to provide a theoretical benchmark for the proposed multi-view direction-sensing system. Simulation results show that logistic-weighted fusion achieves better accuracy in the very low-SNR regime, while both proposed methods approach the CRLB at medium and high SNRs and maintain stable sensing performance.

AI.tldr: 提出多臂阵列（多朝向子阵）实现宽空域覆盖与多视角测向，并给出SNR加权与logistic加权两种融合方法，推导CRLB作为理论基准。
AI.motivation: 定向天线波束导致目标偏离阵列视轴时接收功率下降、测向精度退化；可旋转阵列虽可缓解但引入额外感知时延，需在方向增益与低时延之间取得折中。
AI.method: 设计由不同朝向子阵构成的多臂阵列以获得宽空间覆盖与多视角观测；提出基于估计接收SNR的SNR加权融合与基于指数SNR映射（强化高SNR子阵）的logistic加权融合；推导CRLB作为性能下界。
AI.result: 仿真表明logistic加权融合在极低SNR下精度更优，两种融合方法在中高SNR下均逼近CRLB，且感知性能稳定。
AI.conclusion: 多臂多视角阵列结合加权融合可在不增加旋转时延的前提下提升低空与地面目标的测向精度，CRLB验证了方法的近最优性。

title: Inter-Cell Interference Suppression for Channel Estimation and Data Detection in MIMO-OFDM Systems via Score-Based Variational Inference
summary: In multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) systems, conventional receivers based on linear channel estimation and subband-averaged interference covariance reconstruction suffer serious performance degradation under strong interference. To address this issue, we propose a probabilistic framework for joint channel estimation and interference suppression using score-based prior learning. Specifically, we formulate a variational inference problem that exploits the bilinear structure of the interference by explicitly separating the interference channels from the interference symbols. To solve the resulting highly nonconvex bilinear inference problem, we develop a score-based variational inference algorithm that combines score-based turbo message passing for target-channel estimation with a reverse mean propagation framework for interference-channel inference, while the interference symbols are updated via linear minimum mean square error (LMMSE) estimation. We further design an interference rejection combining (IRC) detector with subcarrier-level covariance reconstruction based on the estimated interference channels, thereby avoiding the performance loss caused by conventional subband averaging. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm is able to effectively suppress the interference in channel estimation, as well as to accurately reconstruct the interference subspace for interference rejection in data detection, and thus significantly outperforms existing baselines.

title: SiteEvo: An LLM Agent for Autonomous Discovery of Site-Adaptive Massive MIMO Detectors
summary: Designing a massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) detector that is tailored to each specific deployment site can improve detection performance, yet most existing detectors, including deep-unfolding methods, adapt mainly within human-prescribed algorithmic structures. This letter proposes SiteEvo, a site-adaptive agentic discovery framework that extends adaptation from parameter tuning to detector-algorithm discovery. Rather than selecting or recombining predefined architectures, the large language model (LLM) agent synthesizes complete executable detector programs under a common design contract by combining its pretrained communication knowledge, site-specific wireless evidence, and experience accumulated during the search. Each proposal defines its own processing structure and trainable parameterization, and the parameters are optimized by a communication-system backend. The resulting high-performance detector is further structurally refined to reduce block-level computational cost under a bit error rate (BER)-preservation constraint and is finally frozen for deployment without online LLM inference. Simulations across three sites demonstrate BER reductions by factors of 2.6 to 6.0 over the best-performing competing detector at each site at 6 dB, while structural refinement reduces block-level computational cost by 16.7-34.1% under a validation-BER constraint.

title: RF Fingerprinting of DSP Implementations using Machine Learning: An Over-the-Air Case Study
summary: Radio frequency fingerprinting aims to identify transmitters by exploiting small differences in the emitted signal waveform. Common approaches exploit hardware-dependent imperfections for that purpose. This work instead investigates whether differences between digital signal processing implementations of a transmitter can be identified from their radiated signals. As a practical case study, five different software-based DSP implementations for generating a 2-FSK RTTY communication waveform are considered. In a monitoring receiver, a classifier can identify these DSP implementations using convolutional neural networks that are trained on augmented software-generated signals represented as raw IQ, power spectrum or instantaneous frequency. The trained networks are evaluated on over-the-air recordings obtained using a shortwave transceiver and a software-defined radio receiver. The best neural network combines IQ and the power spectrum representation and achieves an accuracy of up to 90%. The study further examines the influence of the signal SNR and the observation bandwidth on the classification accuracy. The results demonstrate that DSP implementations leave distinguishable characteristics in the transmitted signals and suggest that DSP-dependent fingerprinting can provide complementary information for specific emitter identification systems.

title: Rate-Distortion Theory of Gaussian Mixtures via Posterior Label Sampling
summary: We study the mean-squared error (MSE) rate-distortion function (RDF) of finite Gaussian mixture models (GMMs) in $\mathbb{R}^d$, for which neither the RDF nor an optimal test channel is known in closed form. It can be sandwiched between the genie-aided conditional RDF $R_{\mathbf{X} | T}(D)$, which can be characterized in closed-form for a GMM, and $R_{\mathbf{X} | T}(D)+I(\mathbf{X};T)$, where $T$ denotes the latent component label. We show that the upper bound can be achieved operationally by the proposed Gibbs-relabelling method (GRM), which conveys a label from the posterior $P_{T|\mathbf{X}}$ through \textit{channel simulation} at rate $I(\mathbf{X};T)$, followed by vector quantization of the resulting exactly Gaussian conditional sources by reverse water-filling. Using the Shannon lower bound (SLB), we prove that GRM attains the SLB, and hence the RDF, of a general finite mixture if and only if every component attains its own SLB. For a GMM this holds throughout the fully active interval $D/d<\min_{k,m}\lambda_{k,m}$, where $\lambda_{k,m}$ are the eigenvalues of the component covariances, and for scalar GMMs the condition is also necessary. Since GRM cannot operate below the label cost $I(\mathbf{X};T)$, we propose a complementary stochastic scalar quantization (SSQ) scheme for low rates, which simulates an $M$-ary reconstruction index. We show that at low rates SSQ with $M\geq 2$ matches the Shannon RDF to first order: $R(D_{\max}-\delta)=\delta/(2\tau^2)+o(\delta)$, where $\tau^2$ is a directional sub-Gaussian proxy of the mixture, and quantify the price of a finite codebook through a strict rate gap at high rates and a distortion floor whose joint scaling in $M$ and number of mixture components is characterized. Numerical results illustrate both regimes and the finite-blocklength cost of channel simulation.

title: Physical Layer Security for Movable Antenna-Aided Mixed-Field ISAC
summary: Movable antenna (MA) can enhance the physical layer security (PLS) performance of integrated sensing and communications (ISAC). However, most existing works assume either near-field (NF) or far-field (FF) propagation models for both communication users (CUs) and targets. This paper considers a more practical scenario where multiple CUs, an eavesdropper (Eve), and multiple targets are in a mixed near- and far-field environment due to the changes in the propagation field caused by antenna position updates in MA with a unified array response and continuous NF/FF weights. To evaluate the PLS performance of MA-aided ISAC in mixed-field environments, we formulate an optimization problem to maximize the sum secrecy rate (SSR) of CUs by jointly designing the transmit beamforming and antenna positions at the transmitter. The problem is highly non-convex, so a two-layer algorithm is proposed to iteratively solve the problem using the projected gradient ascent (PGA) method and the Lagrangian dual transform. Since the abrupt switch between the NF and the FF models during antenna movement can cause the objective function to oscillate during iteration, the unified array response is combined with the Barzilai-Borwein step, Armijo line search, and precise projection to ensure that the SSR does not decrease during the iteration and the objective function is differentiable on the Rayleigh boundary. Numerical results show that the MA-ISAC using the mixed-field model achieves almost identical PLS performance to that of using the full NF model in terms of SSR, and both outperform the FF model. Using the mismatched FF model during antenna position updates results in a loss of MA gain, potentially making MA inferior to the FA-based system using the correct model.

title: Binary Codes Correcting Multiple Edits via Polynomial Hashing and Entropy Recycling
summary: Codes in the Levenshtein metric that can correct multiple edits (including deletions, insertions, and substitutions) have attracted a lot of attention recently owing to their application in DNA-based storage and racetrack memories. In this work, we present new techniques for designing explicit binary codes of length $n$ that correct $t$ edits with at most $(2t+1)\log n+O_t(\log\log n)$ bits of redundancy. We first propose to use a polynomial hash to construct a systematic code that corrects $t$ edits with $(4t+2)\log n+O_t(\log\log n)$ bits of redundancy. Then we observe that there are many polynomial hashes like this, some are good, some are bad. So, we propose the second technique, called entropy recycling, to use the indices of good hashes to carry information. As a consequence, we obtain a partial-systematic code of length $n$ that corrects $t$ edits with at most $(2t+1)\log n+O_t(\log\log n)$ bits of redundancy. Finally, we provide deterministic polynomial-time encoding and decoding algorithms for our code.

title: Bistatic Delay-Doppler Sensing for 3D Target Localization in Distributed Wi-Fi Systems
summary: This paper investigates how bistatic delay information improves the observability and localization performance of 3D moving targets in distributed Wi-Fi sensing. Motivated by emerging IEEE 802.11bf WLAN sensing, we consider one transmitter, multiple distributed receivers, and a single target with unknown position and velocity. We compare Doppler-only sensing with delay-Doppler sensing, in which delay-capable receivers provide additional bistatic path-length information for target localization. We derive the Fisher information matrix (FIM) and the position equivalent FIM (EFIM) for both sensing formulations. The resulting observability analysis shows that Doppler-only localization generically requires six receivers, whereas delay-Doppler localization can become locally identifiable with three receivers under non-degenerate geometry. We further study mixed receiver architectures in which only a subset of receivers provides delay estimates. Simulations with Wi-Fi-like bandwidths confirm the transition and quantify the roles of bandwidth, Doppler noise, receiver geometry, and delay-capable receiver availability.

title: Theoretical Investigation of Nonclassical Directional Emission in 1D and 2D Quantum-Dot Antenna Arrays and Quantum DoA Estimation
summary: A quantum-dot array prepared in a timed Dicke state exhibits directional radiation asymmetry, which has often been interpreted as evidence of reciprocity breaking through quantum-state preparation. We show that this interpretation is incorrect: reciprocity concerns transmit-receive response, not necessarily pattern symmetry. Moreover, the first-order coherence of any single-excitation state is exactly equivalent to the power pattern of a classical phased array driven by conjugate weights, making the observed asymmetry classically reproducible. The genuine quantum signature instead appears in second-order correlations, where a single-excitation state violates the classical lower bound on photon coincidences. We therefore propose a quantum-antenna certificate combining nonzero directional asymmetry with photon antibunching at the beam peak. We further derive a tight asymmetry bound, establish the correct mirror operation for planar arrays, correct the collective decay rate with dipole-dipole coupling, and derive a saturation law for direction-finding precision. All theoretical results are validated through independent numerical implementations.

title: Exact Sampling Under Campbell Cost via Rényi Channel Simulation Divergence
summary: We study the communication cost of exact sampling under Campbell's exponential coding criterion. Given a target distribution $P$ and a proposal distribution $Q$, the sender and receiver share i.i.d. $Q$-distributed samples, and the sender communicates an index so that the selected sample has distribution exactly $P$. We introduce a new information measure Rényi channel simulation divergence $R_\alpha(P\Vert Q)$, a Rényi generalization of the channel simulation divergence. We then show that it lower bounds the Campbell cost of every exact sampler and is achievable, via a new layered sampling scheme, within an additive constant depending only on the Campbell parameter. This yields a tighter one-shot characterization than previous bounds based on Rényi divergences of different orders. For i.i.d. product distributions, under suitable non-degeneracy and moment conditions, we further show that the gap beyond the leading Rényi-divergence term is $\frac{1}{2}\log n+O(1)$.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在Campbell指数编码准则下精确采样的通信代价，提出Rényi信道模拟散度R_α(P‖Q)，证明其为精确采样器Campbell代价的下界且可通过分层采样方案达到（差距仅为依赖Campbell参数的加性常数），并给出i.i.d.乘积分布下更紧的一次性刻画。

title: Correcting Burst Errors with Applications to DNA-Based Data Storage
summary: We introduce the problem of permutation burst error-correction, motivated by applications in molecular data storage with nanopore sequencing read platforms. A permutation burst of length $k$ is an error that affects a substring of length $k$ of a string of length $n$ by permuting its entries. Permutation burst errors can be corrected using classical burst error-correcting codes, such as Fire and Reed-Solomon codes. Here, we study how to reduce the redundancy of these classical codes by taking into account that the burst error preserves the weight of the substring. In addition, we further restrict our model to handle cyclic permutation bursts only, which are of independent practical and mathematical interest. Our main results include proving/establishing the following: a) for $k=o(\sqrt{n}),$ the redundancy of any permutation burst error correcting code is at least $\log n-k+\log \binom{2k-2}{k-2}+o(1).$ This result follows from McDiarmid's concentration bound; b) for $k \geq 9$ and $k=o\left(\sqrt{\frac{n}{\log n}}\right)$, the redundancy of any cyclic permutation burst error correcting code is at least $\log n +\log (k(k-1)-56)-\log\,80+o(1).$ c) the asymptotic redundancy upper bounds for the two types of substring errors that are twice the lower bound; d) constructions for both permutation burst and cyclic permutation burst errors that involve Varshamov-Tenegoltz type constraints or represent generalizations and extensions of Fire and other codes. In particular, we exhibit polynomially encodable and decodable codes that can correct cyclic bursts of length $\leq k$ using $\log n + k + 49\log k + O(\log \log k)$ redundant bits.

title: On the Average List Size of VT Codes under Two Insertions or Two Deletions
summary: Levenshtein's classical theorem shows that any code that can uniquely decode from \(t\) deletions can also uniquely decode from \(t\) insertions. This symmetry, however, does not generally hold in the list-decoding regime. Several prior results on the capacity and radii of list-decoding from insertions and deletions suggest that insertions are easier to handle than deletions. In an effort to better understand this asymmetry between insertions and deletions under list-decoding, we study an analogous version of McEliece's \emph{average list size problem}. More precisely, given a binary code \(\mathcal{C}\) of length \(n\) that uniquely corrects \(t'\) insertions (or deletions), we are interested in the average number of codewords returned by a \(t\)-insertion (or deletion) list decoder, where \(t' < t\). Focusing on the case of \(t'=1\) and \(t=2\), we find that under two insertions, this quantity is at most \((n+12)/4\) for any VT code of length \(n\), whereas under two deletions it is at least \(n/2 - 10\) when averaged over all length-\(n\) VT codes. The nearly factor-of-two gap between these upper and lower bounds serves to confirm the relative ease of list-decoding of insertions compared to deletions from an average-case perspective.
